title: Jiangshi in the Pocket
tagline: It is nine at night. At the third watch he comes for you. Lay him to rest, or be standing when he arrives.

tileBlurbs._note: One line per tile, for the gallery. What the place is, not what it does — the mechanics come from tiles.json.
tileBlurbs.gatehouse: Where you start. Three ways on, and the gate shut behind you.
tileBlurbs.apothecary: One door. Drawers of herbs, a balance, a mortar still full.
tileBlurbs.woodshed: Poles and axes, close to the start.
tileBlurbs.sutra-hall: Scripture and talismans. The richest magic in the game.
tileBlurbs.mourning-hall: Where the coffins are laid out, under two white banners.
tileBlurbs.courtyard: The crossroads. Roofless, and its moon gate is the only way outside.
tileBlurbs.blacksmith: One door. The forge — iron is anti-yin, and the coals are still live.
tileBlurbs.counting-room: Ledgers, an abacus, and the clerk’s own medicine chest behind the desk.
tileBlurbs.incense-hall: Tablets in tiers. One coil is still burning, and it burns out once.
tileBlurbs.sealed-crypt: The coffin nobody claimed, papered shut. The tablet is here.
tileBlurbs.back-steps: The stone landing outside the moon gate.
tileBlurbs.dry-well: Where the village threw what it wanted gone.
tileBlurbs.memorial-arch: Offerings and tools stacked at its foot.
tileBlurbs.pavilion: Somewhere to sit, if this were a different night.
tileBlurbs.pagoda-tree: 鬼樹. It heals because it is literally a medicine tree.
tileBlurbs.stone-ward: The stone at the junction. Every route outdoors crosses it.
tileBlurbs.stream: Running water. They cannot cross it, so their blows land on nothing.
tileBlurbs.earth-god-shrine: The land god knows where the dead are buried. Ask once.
tileBlurbs.mass-grave: The pit for the unclaimed. Bury the tablet here.
